plan.purpose: configuration selection on new validation graphs, followed by locked held-out evaluation
plan.development: All synthetic-20261018 and public-preset-20261018 graphs are development data; do not report them as unseen test data.
plan.selection: Select separately per definition by mean over validation instances of (mean seed solution size / degree-greedy size); ties within 1e-12 choose narrower width, then CRA. Never inspect test outcomes to select.
plan.timing: 5s approximate wall-time target for setup+training neural, final decoder extra; random restart checks between completed trials; SCIP solver target subtracts Python model and warm-start construction time. Save actual total, setup, solver and decode time; no strict hard-deadline or speed superiority claim.
plan.architecture: Unmodified public src.models wrapper, hidden widths w and w/2, BN on, effective dropout zero, uniform node features, Adam 1e-4, weight decay 5e-8, penalty 2. Only width and CRA on/off varied.
plan.schedule: CRA = -1 + 1.6 * elapsed setup+training / target seconds; no-CRA = 0. Retain last pre-update training-mode outputs, consistent with public preset's output convention.
plan.evidence: Save threshold, repaired, extended and first-forward untrained outputs with same decoder; fixed seeds repeat within instance, not independent samples. Report descriptive instance-level paired effects; no p-values. Dense/indexed kernel comparison is a separate numerical/performance experiment, not a new mathematical objective.

selection.criterion: Select separately per definition by mean over validation instances of (mean seed solution size / degree-greedy size); ties within 1e-12 choose narrower width, then CRA. Never inspect test outcomes to select.

protocol.limits: Three public upstream versions, no tuning on their outcomes; data identities and redundancy caveats in docs/data-provenance.md.
